QF.id: AIFM CIII Fee Structure and Fund Performance_1

question.text: Himalaya Arbitrage Fund (Cat III open-ended) charges a management fee of 1.5% on Gross NAV (GNAV) at year-end, plus 18% GST. GNAV as on 31-March is INR 120 crore. What is the TOTAL cost to the fund toward management fees for the year (fee + GST)?

explanation.text: The Logic: Management fee = 1.5% x INR 120 cr = INR 180 lakh. GST @18% on fee = 18% x 180 = INR 32.40 lakh. Total cost to fund = 180 + 32.40 = INR 212.40 lakh. In Cat III AIFs, management fee is charged on GNAV (not on committed capital as in Cat I/II PE funds). The Trap: INR 180 lakh ignores GST. INR 216 lakh treats the fee as inclusive-of-GST (180*1.20). INR 240 lakh wrongly uses 2% management fee. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-D (Cat I/II Manager) would calculate fee on committed capital (e.g., 2% on INR 100 cr committed even if only INR 60 cr called). XIX-E Cat III uses GNAV — tested here. Manager's Pro-Tip: On a daily-NAV Cat III fund, management fee accrues daily in NAV so subscription/redemption prices are clean; don't book the quarterly cash outflow a second time into NAV — double-charge risk is a classic fund-admin bug.
